title: Solar Installer Questions to Ask Before Signing: A Guide for American Homeowners
excerpt: Before signing with a solar installer, ask these essential questions to ensure a successful solar panel installation.
content:
Section 1: Research and Reputation

Start by researching the solar installer's reputation, licenses, and certifications. Check online reviews, ask for referrals from friends or family, and verify their physical address. Look for installers that are certified by reputable organizations such as the North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP).

Section 2: System Design and Installation

Ask about their design and installation process, including the type of solar panels and equipment they use. Ensure they have experience with your roof type and size. Inquire about their installation timeline, ensuring it fits your schedule and budget.

Section 3: Financing and Incentives

Discuss financing options, including loans and leases, and their associated costs. Ask about available federal, state, and local incentives, and how they can help reduce your solar panel costs. Be aware of any potential tax credits or rebates.

Section 4: Warranty and Maintenance

Understand the warranty offered by the solar installer, including the duration and coverage. Ask about their maintenance and repair services, including monitoring and cleaning. Ensure they have a plan in place for addressing any system issues or defects.

Conclusion

By asking these essential questions, you'll be well-equipped to choose a reliable solar installer and ensure a successful solar panel installation. Visit SolarAtlas to find solar data for your city.
